PLAN "12-week Bodyweight Strength for Beginner (Minimal Equipment)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with bodyweight progressions"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Push & Core":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dip 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower & Posterior":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          back_extension 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Pull & Core":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x3..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..16 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..40 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
